verdict.rationale: Fern clearly generates hosted API Reference documentation from OpenAPI specs. This includes per-type pages for GraphQL schemas and versioned API references, which covers the 'explore an API reference' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser API playground or try-it console, or that it provides runnable code examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
